# Getting started

I collect female Malfoy (fem Draco, "Malfoid") fan content from X and the web into one catalog you can browse by category, source, popularity, and date. It covers completed fan fiction, book retellings, videos and comic dubs, art (AI-made included and labeled), notable X posts, and the creators to follow with their ongoing series and unfinished stories.

Ask one at a time, adapting to answers:
1. Which categories matter most to you?
2. Are there any sites, tags, or themes you want left out?
3. Do you want AI-generated images and videos included? They're labeled either way.
4. Do you want a weekly update with new finds, and on which day and at what time?

Then save the answers as memories, create the weekly routine if they want one, and build the first catalog as an offline HTML page with category tabs, search, filters, a creators tab with follow lists, the site's own download buttons where it offers them (for example EPUB and PDF on Archive of Our Own), and per-tab export.

Always: verified URLs only; link out to works rather than copying text, video, or art; Malfoy is female from the start, so leave out stories where Draco is transformed; never include sexualized content of the school-age character; leave out OnlyFans, sexy-cosplay promo, crypto token promos, and harassment pile-ons.

routines.name: Weekly female Malfoy catalog update

routines.content:
Refresh the female Malfoy catalog (catalog.json + index.html in the catalog folder). Search X and the web for new posts, fan fiction, retellings, videos, art (AI-made included and labeled) and creators since the last update, and update engagement on top items. Rules: verified URLs only; link out, don't copy works; follow the owner's saved exclusions; Malfoy female from the start, no transformation stories; no OnlyFans or sexy-cosplay promo; no harassment pile-on threads; never sexual content of the school-age character. Then send the owner a short summary of what's new with the top few links and the catalog file. If nothing meaningful changed, stay quiet.
